units.source_text: “十月里有一天，月白风清之夜，我正要从宫中退出，有一个殿上人招呼我，要搭我的车子。

en.t: One night in October, when the moon was bright and the wind was clear, I was just about to leave the palace when a court gentleman called out to me, wanting to ride in my carriage.

units.source_text: 这时候我正想到大纳言[\[9\]](#part1331.html#m9)家去宿夜，这贵族说：

en.t: At the time I was on my way to spend the night at the Great Counselor's house, and the nobleman said,

units.source_text: ‘今晚有一个女子在等候我，要是不去，我心里怪难过的。’

en.t: Tonight a woman is waiting for me; if I do not go, I shall feel terribly distressed.
So I set out with him in the same carriage.

units.source_text: 我那个女子的家，正好位在我们所要经过的路上。

en.t: The woman's house happened to stand right along the road we had to take.

units.source_text: 车子到了她家门口，我从土墙坍塌之处望见庭中一池碧水，映着月影，清幽可爱。

en.t: When the carriage reached her gate, I looked through a crumbled place in the earthen wall and saw a pool of clear green water in the garden, reflecting the moonlight, quiet and lovely.

units.source_text: 过门不入，岂不大杀风景？

en.t: Would it not spoil the whole charm to pass the gate without going in?

units.source_text: 岂知这殿上人就在这里下车，我也悄悄地跟着下车了。

en.t: To my surprise, the court gentleman got out there, and I quietly got down after him.

units.source_text: 他大约是和这女子有约的，得意扬扬地走进去，在门旁廊沿上坐下了，暂时赏玩月色。

en.t: He had probably made an appointment with the woman, for he went in looking quite pleased with himself, sat down on the veranda by the gate, and for a while admired the moonlight.

units.source_text: 庭中残菊经霜，颜色斑斓，夜风习习，红叶散乱，景色颇有情趣。

en.t: In the garden, late chrysanthemums touched by frost showed variegated colors; the night wind blew softly, fallen red leaves lay scattered, and the scene had a deep charm.

units.source_text: 这贵族便从怀中取出一支短笛，吹了一会，又信口唱起催马乐来：

en.t: The nobleman then took a short flute from inside his robe, played it for a while, and casually began to sing a saibara song:
The tree shadows are lovely, and the pond water too is clear and pure...

units.source_text: 这时候室内发出美妙的和琴[\[11\]](#part1331.html#m11)声，敢是预先调好弦音的吧，

en.t: Just then, a beautiful sound of the wagon came from inside the room; perhaps its strings had been tuned in advance,

units.source_text: 和着歌声，流畅地弹出，手法的确不坏！

en.t: for it joined the singing and was played out smoothly; the skill was certainly not poor.

units.source_text: 这曲调在女子手上委婉地弹奏，隔帘听来，好似现代乐器的声音，与目前的月夜景色十分调和。

en.t: In the woman's hands the melody was played with gentle grace, and heard through the curtain it sounded almost like a modern instrument, harmonizing perfectly with the moonlit scene before us.

units.source_text: 这殿上人大为感动，走近帘前，说了些令人不快的话：

en.t: The court gentleman was deeply moved, went close to the curtain, and said something rather unpleasant:

units.source_text: ‘庭中满地红叶，全无来人足迹啊！’

en.t: The garden is covered with red leaves, yet there are no footprints at all from visitors.

units.source_text: 然后折了一枝菊花，吟道：

en.t: Then he broke off a branch of chrysanthemum and recited:
